animations.name: Light Kick
animations.prompt: time 0-0.4s: Start in the supplied idle guard facing RIGHT. Shift weight onto the supporting leg and lift only the kicking knee, with a short controlled preparation. time 0.4-1s: Execute exactly ONE light kick: the grounded outward side kick: front leg extended right at waist height, knee nearly straight, sole angled toward viewer, other leg planted, torso angled slightly toward viewer and leaning left, one fist raised beside the head and other arm balancing. Reach the supplied kick keyframe at 1s. time 1-2s: Retract that same leg, bend the knee, replace the foot in its original position and smoothly restore the exact starting idle guard. Keep the planted foot stable, preserve face, outfit, proportions, 16-bit pixel art, 512x512 framing and padding. Fixed camera. One kick and one recovery; no extra strikes, jumps, spins or added effects.
